gemini.title.singleplayer.tooltip: Pick or create a single-player world. Gemini runs here.
gemini.title.multiplayer.tooltip: Open the server list. While sandbox mode is on, Gemini explains how to switch itself off first.
gemini.title.realms.tooltip: Open Minecraft Realms. Realms connections are refused while sandbox mode is on.
gemini.title.clickgui.tooltip: Open the classic panel menu to set up modules, settings and keybinds. Modules can only be switched on inside a single-player world.
gemini.title.windowgui.tooltip: Open the window menu to set up modules, settings and keybinds. Modules can only be switched on inside a single-player world.
gemini.title.configs.tooltip: Manage presets, profiles and saved configs.
gemini.title.disabled.tooltip: Gemini is switched off. Turn sandbox mode back on to configure it.
gemini.title.vanilla.tooltip: Use the vanilla title screen from now on. The Gemini menu button there brings this screen back.
gemini.title.home.tooltip: Use the Gemini home screen instead of this title screen.
gemini.dock.clickgui.tooltip: ClickGUI: the classic panel menu, one draggable column per category.
gemini.dock.windowgui.tooltip: WindowGUI: the single window menu with a sidebar.
gemini.dock.hud.tooltip: HUD Layout Editor: drag the HUD widgets into place.
gemini.dock.configs.tooltip: Config Manager: presets, profiles and saved configs.
gemini.dock.keybinds.tooltip: Keybind Report: every bound module by key, with shared keys marked.
gemini.dock.panic.tooltip: Panic: switch every module off at once.
gemini.keybinds.title: Keybind Report
